name: enrichment_gsea
description: TU-level abundance set enrichment (fgsea) per term with TU-set permutations (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.7.4, §9.3; M8-02, M8-05, M8-06). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: collection
fields.description: Collection of the term

fields.name: term
fields.description: Term ID

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable term name; NA when the resource has none

fields.name: size_tus
fields.description: Term size, in TUs (ranked TUs with a member gene)

fields.name: es
fields.description: Enrichment score

fields.name: nes
fields.description: Normalised enrichment score; NA when unestimated

fields.name: log2err
fields.description: Standard deviation of the log2 p-value estimate; NA when not estimated

fields.name: leading_edge
fields.description: Semicolon-joined leading-edge genes; NA when empty

fields.name: redundant
fields.description: A GO term whose signal is explained by a more significant related term; NA outside GO

fields.name: parent_group
fields.description: Most general ancestor of the redundant group of a GO term; NA otherwise

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Share of eligible genes with at least one term of this collection

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Test statistic: es

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Effect estimate: nes

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower CI bound; NA when not estimated (ci_unestimated)

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper CI bound; NA when not estimated (ci_unestimated)

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: Permutation p-value

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: BH q-value within the collection

fields.name: method
fields.description: Method: fgsea_multilevel (R fgsea, ADR-0038) or fgsea_simple (the M8-02 port)

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null model

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Permutations behind the p-value

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined row flags
